objective: Reduce the direction-sampling uncertainty of the selection-aware matched representation-minus-prompt injection calibration.
analysis: Identical appended-site selection, exact 12,870-assignment null, prompt-64 comparator, folds, classifier, regularization, and p<0.01 rule as the parent calibration.
reporting: Combine seeds 0--19 only after all parent and extension reports pass hash and complement-symmetry gates; report the detection fraction with a Wilson 95% interval at each signal level.
provenance_limit: This precision extension was specified after the d=0.5 parent results were available but before any d=1, d=2, or d=4 parent result was available. It is post-hoc simulation calibration, not benchmark evidence.
claim_limit: Injected directions are simulation replicates, not model, dataset, or training-seed replicates. The result calibrates one model and panel and does not establish a mechanism.
